description: This is a kernel package build definition file, defining the configuration and metadata for SPI controller driver modules for the BCM2835 chipset in the Linux kernel, specific to the OpenWrt build system.

methods.name: KernelPackage/spi-bcm2835
methods.description: Defines the BCM2835 SPI master controller driver package with associated metadata.

methods.name: KernelPackage/spi-bcm2835-aux
methods.description: Defines the BCM2835 auxiliary SPI controller driver package with associated metadata.
